description: A curated knowledge base of our team's technical methodology — architecture decisions, implementation patterns, operational practices, and lessons learned. Each module captures HOW we approach a topic, not just what it means. Use the index to identify relevant modules, then load the ones you need. Prefer modules with higher confidence ratings. Cross-reference related modules when topics overlap.

safety.name: safety
safety.description: Topics: 5-Why, 5-why, HAZOP, HSE, HSE绩效, IoT, JSA, KPI. Modules include: 事故管理“四不放过”及根本原因分析; 交工技术文件与安全记录归档; 受限空间作业气体控制标准; 受限空间作业气体检测与监护要求; 受限空间专项治理

modules.title: 事故管理“四不放过”及根本原因分析
modules.summary: 我们严格执行“四不放过”原则，事故调查报告7个工作日内完成，其中必须包含5-Why根本原因分析和整改措施。

modules.title: 交工技术文件与安全记录归档
modules.summary: 项目开工前确定交工文件清单，强制收录所有安全相关记录（压力试验、NDT报告、热处理等），保证安全足迹完整可追溯。

modules.title: 受限空间作业气体控制标准
modules.summary: 坚持“先通风、再检测、后作业”流程，设定多种气体浓度阈值，并实施2小时复测和双监护制度。

modules.title: 受限空间作业气体检测与监护要求
modules.summary: 我们坚持“先通风、再检测、后作业”，定义氧气、可燃气、H₂S、CO等具体容许浓度，作业中每2小时复测，配备双监护。

modules.title: 受限空间专项治理
modules.summary: 我们对全部在建项目重新辨识受限空间并复核审批流程，重点防范残留油气等风险。

modules.title: 受限空间重新辨识与审批流程复核
modules.summary: 我们开展受限空间专项治理，对全项目受限空间进行二次辨识并强化审批流程，以防止因辨识遗漏或程序执行松懈造成的中毒窒息事故。

modules.title: 承包商安全绩效排名与末位约谈
modules.summary: 我们每半年对全部80家承包商进行安全绩效量化排名，并对末位3家进行约谈，以市场手段倒逼承包商自主改进HSE管理。

modules.title: 承包商安全绩效评价
modules.summary: 我们对全部80家承包商进行半年安全绩效排名，末位3家约谈，以督促承包商改进安全表现。

modules.title: 应急演练完成率管理
modules.summary: 应急演练完成率Q2为85%，未达100%目标，我们将加强计划执行和考核以提升。

modules.title: 应急响应分级与上报时效
modules.summary: 按事故严重程度划分三级响应，并规定对应的响应启动层级和严格的上报时限，实现快速分级处置。

modules.title: 施工区域应急物资标准配置
modules.summary: 我们在每个施工区域设置应急物资点，清单包含急救箱、空呼、防毒面具等，每月1日由HSE部检查补充。

modules.title: 应急物资配置与定期检查
modules.summary: 每个施工区域标准配备急救箱、呼吸器、防毒面具等应急物资，并由HSE部每月1日固定检查补充。

modules.title: 暑期高温作业防暑降温应对机制
modules.summary: 我们启动高温时段作业调整机制，当气温≥35°C时改变作业时间、配发防暑物资，并有标准化的药品和饮品配备清单，以防止热射病和疲劳引发的事故。

modules.title: 高处作业安全防护与脚手架验收
modules.summary: 定义2米以上为高处作业，强制安全带高挂低用，系挂点承载力不低于15kN，脚手架实行三方联合验收挂牌。

modules.title: 动火作业分级审批与防护
modules.summary: 将动火作业分为三级，由不同管理层级审批，并配置固定消防资源和天气限制条件，执行“十不准”制度。

modules.title: 动火作业分级审批与防控措施
modules.summary: 我们按风险高低将动火作业分为三级，分别由项目经理、HSE经理、施工队长审批，并执行“动火作业十不准”及风力限制。

modules.title: 事故调查与根本原因分析法
modules.summary: 执行“四不放过”原则，事故调查报告须在7个工作日内完成，并采用5-Why法追溯根本原因。

modules.title: 检验试验计划（ITP）与关键检查点
modules.summary: 我们在单位工程开工前编制ITP，定义H点（停工待检点）、W点（见证点）、R点（审查点）三类强制检查点，确保质量和安全不可逆环节受控。

modules.title: 关键安全绩效指标（KPI）监控体系
modules.summary: 我们使用百万工时伤害率（LTIFR）、可记录伤害率（TRIR）等核心KPI，并进行环比与年度目标对比，以量化安全生产趋势并驱动改进。

modules.title: 主要风险源分级管理
modules.summary: 我们按风险等级对TOP5风险源排序，聚焦重大风险项目，实施分级管控。

modules.title: 变更管理（MOC）与安全风险评估
modules.summary: 任何设计、工艺、设备、材料的变更都必须经过结构化MOC流程，强制进行安全风险评估（HAZOP或JSA），防止非预期变更引发安全事故。

modules.title: 变更管理中的安全风险评估
modules.summary: 所有设计、工艺、设备、材料的变更强制走MOC流程，并必须完成HAZOP或JSA风险分析，分级审批后方可实施。

modules.title: 未遂事件（Near Miss）统计与趋势分析
modules.summary: 我们系统收集并分类未遂事件，将其视为预防重伤和死亡的重要先导性数据源，通过趋势分析驱动预防性干预。

modules.title: 未遂事件（Near Miss）分析
modules.summary: 我们跟踪未遂事件趋势，利用47起近失数据推动前置预防，重点关注吊装偏移和气瓶隐患增加。

modules.title: 职业健康体检率管理
modules.summary: 我们推进职业健康体检率提升，Q2达92.3%，目标≥95%，覆盖接触职业病危害员工。

modules.title: 项目开工前安全许可前置
modules.summary: 开工前必须取得安全生产许可证、危险化学品安全条件审查意见书、消防设计审查及特种设备安装告知，确保合法合规开工。

modules.title: 项目开工前安全许可管理
modules.summary: 所有项目现场作业前必须确保公司资质和项目级安全许可齐全、有效，防止因许可缺失造成停工或法律风险。

modules.title: 隐患整改率目标管理
modules.summary: 我们以隐患整改率≥95%为量化目标，Q2实际94.2%，通过持续改进逼近目标。

modules.title: 风险源等级排序与重大风险判定
modules.summary: 我们采用风险等级R值对所有在建项目风险源进行排序，将R≥15定义为重大风险，优先管控TOP5风险源。

modules.title: Accident investigation and 'Four No Pass' principle
modules.summary: We enforce a root cause-focused investigation completed within 7 working days, using the 5-Why method and the 'Four No Pass' closure rule.

modules.title: Confined space entry protocol
modules.summary: We enforce a strict sequence of ventilation, then gas testing with defined thresholds, periodic re-testing, and double guardian staffing for confined spaces.

modules.title: Tiered emergency response and reporting
modules.summary: We operate three response levels based on incident severity, with defined activation triggers, reporting timelines, and responsible organizations.

modules.title: Standardized emergency supply points and inspection
modules.summary: We designate emergency supply points in every construction area stocked with specific equipment and mandate monthly inspections by the HSE department.

modules.title: Height work and fall protection system
modules.summary: We define height work at 2 m and above, enforce 'high anchor, low use' for harnesses, mandate a 15 kN anchorage, and require joint scaffold acceptance.

modules.title: Hot work permit and control system
modules.summary: We use a three-tier approval hierarchy for hot work permits, strict wind speed cutoffs, and dedicated fire watch with specified fire extinguisher requirements.

modules.title: 安全积分制正面激励体系
modules.summary: 我们推行安全积分制，让员工通过主动上报隐患、参与安全活动等方式获取积分并兑换奖励，以正面引导取代单纯处罚，构建全员参与的安全文化。

modules.title: 员工安全积分制
modules.summary: 我们通过正向激励推动员工主动参与安全，上报隐患和参加活动获得积分兑换奖励。

modules.title: Closed site access and area segregation
modules.summary: We operate a fully enclosed construction site with facial recognition access and physical zoning to prevent unauthorized entry and control hazard exposure.

modules.title: Three-level safety training for site entry
modules.summary: We impose mandatory three-tier safety education with fixed hourly durations before site access to ensure all personnel meet our HSE baseline.

modules.title: 施工现场封闭管理与区域物理隔离
modules.summary: 我们采用人脸识别门禁与物理围栏将施工区、预制区、办公区、生活区隔离，对高风险作业区设置电子围栏和红外报警。

modules.title: 入场安全准入与分区管控
modules.summary: 通过三级安全教育、人证合一验证和全封闭分区物理隔离，实现人员资质管控与施工作业区域风险分离。

modules.title: 智能安全帽试点部署
modules.summary: 我们在惠州项目试点智能安全帽，集成定位、脱帽检测、一键报警，首批500顶。

modules.title: 智能安全帽试点部署
modules.summary: 我们在惠州项目试点500顶集成定位、脱帽检测和SOS一键报警的智能安全帽，利用IoT技术实现现场人员状态的实时监测与应急响应。

modules.title: 分包单位HSE统一管理
modules.summary: 严禁以包代管，将分包单位全面纳入总包方HSE体系，实行统一标准、统一培训、统一考核，从源头控制安全风险。

modules.title: 暑期防暑降温措施
modules.summary: 高温期间（≥35°C）我们调整作业时间，配备防暑药品和饮品，预防热射病。

modules.title: 三级安全教育实施要求
modules.summary: 我们执行三级安全教育制度，所有进场人员必须逐级培训、考试合格后方可上岗，特种作业人员须人证合一。

modules.title: 高处作业安全带使用与脚手架验收
modules.summary: 我们定义坠落基准面2m以上为高处作业，安全带“高挂低用”并确保挂点承载力≥15kN，脚手架需三方联合验收挂牌。

general.name: general
general.description: Topics: abstention, auth, caching, caveats, connection-pool, cross-content, database, direct-hit. Modules include: P5 Reject Test; Phase5 Test Module; Redis Caching with 1-Hour TTL; Retrieval Evaluation Rubric Overview; Overall Pass Criteria Summary

modules.title: P5 Reject Test
modules.summary: Testing rejection

modules.title: Phase5 Test Module
modules.summary: Integration test for Phase 5 verify.

modules.title: Redis Caching with 1-Hour TTL
modules.summary: We use Redis as our caching layer with a default TTL of 1 hour for cached entries.

modules.title: Retrieval Evaluation Rubric Overview
modules.summary: Defines a live test for the knowledge-manager MCP server retrieval using fresh Claude Code sessions and five scenarios.

modules.title: Overall Pass Criteria Summary
modules.summary: A collection of what 'good' looks like across all five scenarios: correct module loading and no fabricated content from unrelated modules.

modules.title: Retrieval Scoring Algorithm
modules.summary: Describes the word-boundary regex scoring used by search_modules to rank candidate modules.

modules.title: Scenario 1: JWT Tokens Direct Hit
modules.summary: Tests retrieval when the query directly matches the module id auth/jwt-tokens.

modules.title: Scenario 2: OAuth Flow Direct Hit
modules.summary: Tests retrieval for the OAuth 2.0 server-side callback flow using the knowledge base.

modules.title: Scenario 3: Connection Pool Direct Hit
modules.summary: Tests retrieval of Postgres connection pool sizing guidance from the database/connection-pool module.

modules.title: Scenario 4: Indirect Cross-Content Match
modules.summary: Tests retrieval when the relevant information is in the caveats field of a module, not in its title or summary.

modules.title: Scenario 5: Out-of-Scope Abstention
modules.summary: Tests that Claude does not hallucinate an answer by loading an unrelated module for an out-of-scope question about Kubernetes ingress.

api.name: api
api.description: Topics: api, documentation, error-handling, headers, http-status-codes, openapi, postman, rate-limiting. Modules include: API Documentation Standards; Rate Limiting Implementation; API Versioning Strategy; HTTP Status Code Usage; RESTful API Design Principles

modules.title: API Documentation Standards
modules.summary: We create comprehensive API documentation with authentication, endpoints, and examples using OpenAPI and Postman to drive adoption and ease of integration.

modules.title: Rate Limiting Implementation
modules.summary: We apply rate limiting with standard response headers and choose algorithms like token bucket based on burst-handling requirements to protect the API and ensure fair usage.

modules.title: API Versioning Strategy
modules.summary: We use URL path versioning for its simplicity and discoverability, accepting the added complexity in HATEOAS management to avoid breaking existing clients.

modules.title: HTTP Status Code Usage
modules.summary: We return precise HTTP status codes to clearly communicate request outcomes, avoiding generic 200 and selecting the most specific code for each situation.

modules.title: RESTful API Design Principles
modules.summary: We design APIs following REST constraints, requiring stateless communication and a uniform interface where resources are identified by URIs and manipulated with standard HTTP methods.

auth.name: auth
auth.description: Topics: access-token, api, authentication, authorization-code, bearer, callback, consent, oauth2. Modules include: API Access Token Usage; Authorization Code Flow Implementation; Authorization Code Return Handling; Token Exchange for Access Token; User Authorization Consent Flow

modules.title: API Access Token Usage
modules.summary: We pass the access token in the Authorization header as a Bearer token for all protected API requests.

modules.title: Authorization Code Flow Implementation
modules.summary: We authenticate users using the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow, exchanging an authorization code for tokens server-side.

modules.title: Authorization Code Return Handling
modules.summary: We receive the temporary authorization code appended to the redirect URI after user consent.

modules.title: Token Exchange for Access Token
modules.summary: We exchange the authorization code for an access token by making a server-to-server POST to the provider's token endpoint.

modules.title: User Authorization Consent Flow
modules.summary: We rely on the provider's consent screen where users explicitly approve requested scopes before granting access.

database.name: database
database.description: Topics: acid, connection-pooling, indexes, isolation, migrations, performance, schema, sql. Modules include: Database Connection Pooling; Database Migrations; Query Optimization; Transaction Management

modules.title: Database Connection Pooling
modules.summary: We maintain a reusable pool of database connections with specific configuration parameters to reduce overhead and improve performance.

modules.title: Database Migrations
modules.summary: We version-control schema changes using incremental, reversible migrations tested on staging before production deployment.

modules.title: Query Optimization
modules.summary: We optimize SQL queries by leveraging indexes, avoiding SELECT *, using EXPLAIN, and batching operations.

modules.title: Transaction Management
modules.summary: We wrap related operations in database transactions, relying on the default READ COMMITTED isolation level to balance consistency and performance.

deployment.name: deployment
deployment.description: Topics: automation, blue-green, build, ci-cd, containers, deployment, docker, kubernetes. Modules include: Blue-Green Deployment; CI/CD Pipeline; Docker Containerization; Kubernetes Deployment; Monitoring and Logging

modules.title: Blue-Green Deployment
modules.summary: We reduce downtime by maintaining two identical environments and switching traffic after validation.

modules.title: CI/CD Pipeline
modules.summary: We automate code delivery with stages from commit to production deployment, ensuring reliable releases.

modules.title: Docker Containerization
modules.summary: We package applications with dependencies into containers using best practices like multi-stage builds and non-root users.

modules.title: Kubernetes Deployment
modules.summary: We orchestrate containerized applications with Kubernetes, using Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.

modules.title: Monitoring and Logging
modules.summary: We monitor request rate, latency, errors, CPU/memory, and connection pools using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Jaeger.
